scope: Whole repo, weighted toward the 6 generator modules never covered by any prior review: ashlar_generator, bead_board_generator, brick_generator, clapboard_generator, radial_brick_generator, shingle_generator
method_note: Single-pass review only. Run inside a forked skill context where the Agent tool was unavailable, so there was no multi-agent fan-out and no independent adversarial verify pass -- unlike the 'full-review' tool that produced ledger.jsonl's 2026-08-08 entry (that tool is local-machine-only, not available in this environment). Findings below are strong leads, not cross-verified. This file is intentionally separate from ledger.jsonl to avoid conflating the two tools' output.

findings.description: RadialBrickGeometry.num_courses floors instead of ceils on the bounded Z axis (unlike every other tiling generator, and unlike its own correct floor use for the boundary-less circumferential axis), leaving a real unbricked band up to ~1 course-height wrapping the full circumference on any non-exact-multiple surface height. No existing test checks courses reach z_max.

The macro is a complete standalone 956-line pre-refactor implementation gated by __main__ that never imports or calls ShingleProxy -- produces a static one-shot shape with no live-parametric regeneration, contradicting README's documented behavior (shared by every sibling macro, which are thin proxy launchers). shingle_proxy.py/shingle_geometry.py themselves are fine; the macro FreeCAD's menu actually runs is not what's documented.

Unguarded link_obj.Shape.getElement(sub_name) in the Sources loop, outside any try/except -- same pattern as 2026-08-08 ledger finding #11 (fixed at High across 12 modules via shared.freecad_utils.resolve_sources_faces), but shingle_generator was out of that review's scope so the fix never reached it. A single stale Sources sub-name fails recompute for the whole object, not just that face.

generate_clapboard_skin/_make_course inline clapboard_geometry.calculate_course_v_positions's count + TOPO_EPS snap math instead of calling it, and the inlined copy is missing the post-loop 'guarantee overflow' fixup the geometry function documents as required. No parity test exists. For wall heights within overlap(0.01mm) but outside TOPO_EPS(0.001mm) of an exact clapboard_height multiple, the last course's v_top lands short of the wall top, leaving a real unfilled sliver -- not just a topological coincidence risk.

generate_bead_board_skin never imports bead_board_geometry; reimplements calculate_bead_positions/calculate_gap_positions (including the TOPO_EPS constant) as an independently-maintained second copy, no parity test. Per CLAUDE.md's proxy/geometry parity rule this is High regardless of current agreement -- the two copies have no coupling point forcing them to stay in sync.

Four proxies hand-roll their own per-face Sources-resolution loop instead of calling shared/freecad_utils.resolve_sources_faces, which all 12 previously-reviewed proxies already use. Inconsistent even among themselves (bead_board_proxy.py is missing the hasattr(link_obj,'Shape') guard the other three have) and lack the skip-counter summary warning added repo-wide by 2026-08-08 ledger finding #30. This duplication is structurally why finding #03 above happened.

completed: all 12 modules from the 2026-08-08 ledger re-touched at lighter weight
scope_gaps.reason: Single-agent single-pass; no independent verify pass was run (Agent tool unavailable in this context) -- treat findings as leads pending verification, not final dispositions.
